name: asc-pricing-manager
description: Read-only App Store Connect regional pricing schedule audits with JSON and CSV artifacts.

interface.shortDescription: Audit App Store regional pricing schedules with read-only ASC API calls.
interface.longDescription: ASC Pricing Manager gives Codex focused knowledge of App Store Connect paid-app pricing APIs. It audits the current app price schedule, manual and automatic prices, included territories, regional app price points, active territory-local customer prices, upcoming and expired schedule rows, and pricing outliers without scheduling or applying price changes.
capabilities: Read-only App Store Connect API access
defaultPrompt: Audit my current regional App Store pricing.
Export App Store price schedule JSON and CSV.
